name: Crushes & Curses
source:
As a novice mage cursed with lost memories, you can’t remember how to wield your magic. In search of answers, you find yourself at Tara’s Tavern.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
作为一名被失去记忆的新手法师，你不记得如何使用你的魔法。为了寻找答案，你来到了塔拉酒馆。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
